references.make: On a 100 × 100 mm Design Page (grid 1 mm, Snap to Grid) draw a 40 × 40 mm square with the Rectangle tool from (10, 10) to (50, 50) mm. Line Not Sewn; colour 800 RED; region sew type Fill Stitch, Direction Manual 0°, Density 4.5, Step pitch 4.0 mm, Frequency 30 %, Pull compensation 0.0 mm, Under sewing ticked (first type, Density Medium), every other region attribute at PE-DESIGN's default. Save with Save As as PES (PE-DESIGN 11's default PES version) under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting you changed in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md).

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN's rows are 1/density apart (density 4.5), unchanged by under sewing

PE-DESIGN 11.50 starts a fill with under sewing on the under sewing's 1 mm inset edge run, at the point nearest the entry ((20,39) for an entry at the middle of the bottom edge), and ends on the outline at the exit (#1088)

PE-DESIGN sews the inset edge run once round, walks on along it to the first under sewing row, and between the two halves walks back along the bottom edge run; OpenStitch sews the same path corner for corner (#1088). It counts one more: OpenStitch's first needle point is on the start (20,39) before its 0.3 mm tie-in, where PE-DESIGN's first is the tie-in's (19.7,39)
